title: Chicken & Squash Saagwala
about: Punjabi-style saag curry: spinach as the star, with sweet roasted squash against the earthy greens.
ingredients: Vegetable bouillon, a small amount, and boiling water (for poaching the chicken)
Cumin seeds and dried red chillies, whole
method: Temper cumin seeds and dried red chillies in oil.
Sauté red onion, garlic, ginger and green chillies. Add ground coriander, cumin, turmeric and tomatoes; cook down to a thick, jammy masala.
Meanwhile roast the squash with oil and salt at 210°C (190°C fan) for 20–25 minutes, until the edges caramelise.
Blanch the spinach for 60 seconds, plunge into ice water to keep it bright green, then blend to a coarse purée.
Stir the purée into the masala, dissolve a small amount of vegetable bouillon in boiling water and add just enough to let the chicken poach, then add the chicken and poach for 8 minutes.
Fold in both the roasted squash and the puréed spinach at the very end so the squash stays intact.
